title: Vietnam vs Cambodia: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Vietnam and Cambodia based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 🍜 Food & Dining
categories.summary: Vietnam is, simply put, one of the best food countries on the planet. Every region has its own distinct cuisine: Hanoi's phở bò (beef pho) and bún chả, Huế's bún bò Huế and bánh bèo, Hội An's cao lầu and white rose dumplings, and Ho Chi Minh City's bánh mì and cơm tấm (broken rice). categories.summary: This is Cambodia's knockout category. Angkor Wat is not just a temple — it's the largest religious monument on Earth, a 162.6-hectare complex that was the center of the Khmer Empire. categories.title: 💰 Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Both countries are extremely affordable by global standards, but Vietnam edges ahead as the cheaper option — especially for daily food and transport. categories.title: 🛵 Getting Around
categories.summary: Vietnam has significantly better transport infrastructure. The Grab app (Southeast Asia's Uber) works seamlessly in all major Vietnamese cities — motorbike taxis for $1–3 across town, cars for $3–8. redditQuotes: Vietnam and Cambodia aren't as easy to city hop as places like Western Europe. You're going to burn through too much time traveling between places."—r/travel user

categories.title: ☀️ Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Cambodia has a simple weather story: dry season (November–April) and wet season (May–October). The sweet spot isNovember to February— temperatures hover around 25–32°C with low humidity and barely any rain. March and April are brutally hot (regularly 38–42°C). categories.title: 🏨 Where to Stay
categories.summary: Hanoi — Old Quarter— The classic base. Chaotic, atmospheric, walkable. Hundreds of hotels, hostels, and street food within arm's reach. Phở Gia Truyền and Bún Chả Hương Liên (Obama's bún chả spot) are minutes away.

categories.title: 🎒 Day Trips
categories.summary: Vietnam's geographic diversity means each base city unlocks different experiences. Cambodia's day trips are more concentrated but no less impressive.

categories.title: 🔀 Why Not Both?
categories.summary: The most popular multi-country route in Southeast Asia isVietnam + Cambodia, and for good reason. faqs.question: Is Vietnam or Cambodia better for first-time visitors to Southeast Asia?
faqs.answer: Vietnam is generally recommended for first-time Southeast Asia visitors. It has better tourist infrastructure, more diverse landscapes, a wider food scene, and reliable ride-hailing apps like Grab. Cambodia is rawer and more off-the-beaten-path, which appeals to adventurous travelers. If Angkor Wat

faqs.question: How much does it cost to travel in Vietnam vs Cambodia per day?
faqs.answer: Vietnam is slightly cheaper overall. Budget travelers spend $25-40/day in Vietnam vs $30-50/day in Cambodia. Mid-range travelers spend $50-80/day in Vietnam vs $60-90/day in Cambodia. Cambodia's heavy reliance on USD means everything feels priced for tourists, while Vietnam's local currency pricing

faqs.question: Can you combine Vietnam and Cambodia in one trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The most popular combo is Ho Chi Minh City to Phnom Penh (6-hour bus, ~$15) then Siem Reap (6-hour bus, ~$12). For 2 weeks, a common split is 10 days Vietnam + 4-5 days Cambodia focused on Siem Reap and Angkor. Budget airlines like VietJet connect major cities for $30-80 one way.

faqs.question: Which country has better food, Vietnam or Cambodia?
faqs.answer: Vietnam wins on food by a wide margin. Vietnamese cuisine (pho, banh mi, bun cha, com tam) is one of the world's great food cultures. faqs.question: Is Cambodia safe for tourists in 2026?
faqs.answer: Cambodia is generally safe for tourists, especially in Siem Reap and Phnom Penh's tourist areas. Watch for bag snatching on motorbikes in Phnom Penh and use reputable transport. Some travelers report more aggressive touts and scams compared to Vietnam, particularly around Angkor Wat.

faqs.question: How long do you need in Vietnam vs Cambodia?
faqs.answer: Vietnam rewards extended stays: 2-3 weeks minimum to see highlights (Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Mekong Delta). faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Vietnam and Cambodia?
faqs.answer: Cambodia is simple: November to February (cool, dry, sunny). Avoid April-May (40C+). Vietnam is trickier spanning 1,650 km with different climate zones.
